work_summary: A1.1 synthetic adapter evidence and the A1.2 launch-locked execution scaffold are both validated. The additive v5 direct-base revision preserves v1-v3 history, binds the official PyTorch linux/amd64 manifest, and removes custom image and nested-container steps from the active path.
